title: Risk Consulting - Digital Risk -Staff- Resilience - Compliance - Cyber
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Risk Consulting – Digital Risk – Staff:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are expanding our
**Resilience, Compliance & Cyber**
team and are looking for
**Staff**
with an interest in operational resilience, technology risk, cyber risk, compliance, and governance domains. We welcome candidates with foundational knowledge and academic or practical exposure across one or more of the following areas:
  
  

* Operational Resilience and Business Continuity Management (BCM)
* Disaster Recovery (DR) and Technology Resilience
* Regulatory Compliance and Controls Assurance
* Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)
* Cyber Risk and Cyber Resilience
* Critical Business Services, Asset, and Dependency Assessments

Staff will support engagement delivery through research, testing preparations, evidence collection, documentation, analysis, and stakeholder coordination while working closely with Seniors and Managers. This role provides an excellent opportunity to build expertise in resilience, compliance, technology risk, and cyber resilience while supporting global client engagements.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support operational resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, cyber resilience, and compliance assessments.
* Assist in conducting Business Impact Analyses (BIA), critical business service reviews, and dependency mapping activities.
* Support reviews of resilience and compliance programs against applicable frameworks and regulations, including ISO 22301, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, DORA, CPS 230, and NIS2.
* Participate in control testing, evidence reviews, walkthroughs, and assurance activities.
* Gather, validate, and document evidence to support assessment conclusions and client deliverables.
* Assist in the evaluation of business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, incident management, and resilience testing programs.
* Support assessments of critical processes, systems, assets, third-party providers, and operational dependencies.
* Participate in stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process walkthroughs.
* Identify observations, risks, and improvement opportunities under the guidance of senior team members.
* Assist in preparing reports, presentations, management summaries, and engagement documentation.
* Support project coordination activities, status tracking, and quality review procedures.
* You will be responsible for executing tasks with increasing autonomy, applying sound judgment within defined parameters, and contributing to team outcomes. You are expected to demonstrate initiative, resolve routine issues independently, and support junior colleagues.
* You will anticipate and identify risks within engagement and share any issues with senior members of the team.
* In line with EY commitment to quality, you'll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Foundational understanding of Operational Resilience, Business Continuity Management (BCM), Disaster Recovery (DR), Crisis Management, and Cyber Resilience concepts.
* Basic understanding of risk management, governance, controls, and regulatory compliance principles.
* Awareness of resilience and compliance frameworks such as ISO 22301, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, DORA, CPS 230, and NIS2.
* Understanding of concepts such as Business Impact Analysis (BIA), Recovery Time Objectives (RTO), Recovery Point Objectives (RPO), critical business services, and dependency mapping.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Good documentation, communication, and report-writing skills.
* Ability to manage assigned tasks and deliver high-quality work within agreed timelines.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to work collaboratively within global and cross-functional teams.
* Interest in developing expertise across resilience, compliance, cyber risk, and technology risk domains.
* Demonstrate AI awareness and proficiency by leveraging approved AI tools to enhance productivity, improve decision-making, and drive innovation while ensuring responsible, ethical, and secure use of AI technologies.
* Champion a growth mindset toward emerging technologies by continuously building AI capabilities, identifying opportunities for AI-driven transformation, and promoting AI adoption and best practices within teams and client engagements.

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Cyber Security, Risk Management, Business Continuity, Information Systems, Computer Science, Technology, or a related field.
* 1-3 years of experience in Operational Resilience, Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, Cyber Security, Technology Risk, Internal Audit, Compliance, or related disciplines.
* Understanding of risk management, cyber security, resilience, compliance, or technology governance principles through academic study, internships, certifications, projects, or professional experience.
* Exposure to control testing, audits, assessments, compliance reviews, or risk management activities is desirable but not mandatory.
* Familiarity with resilience and compliance frameworks, including ISO 22301, ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), DORA, CPS 230, or NIS2, is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and willingness to learn in a consulting environment.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Exposure to Business Continuity Management (BCM), Disaster Recovery (DR), or Operational Resilience concepts through academic projects, internships, certifications, or work experience.
* Basic understanding of cyber security, technology risk, governance, or compliance processes.
* Experience supporting audits, assessments, testing activities, or control reviews.
* Exposure to critical asset assessments, dependency mapping, resilience testing, tabletop exercises, or crisis management activities.
* Proven experience in direct client facing roles, partnering with cross functional teams to deliver assessment and remediation activities.
* Familiarity with GRC, risk management, or compliance tools.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

We are seeking an experienced
**Manager – Microsoft Purview**
to design, implement, and support enterprise data protection and compliance solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Microsoft Purview Data Security services, including
**Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Data Classification and Sensitivity Labelling, Insider Risk Management, and Data Lifecycle Management**
. The candidate should also possess sound understanding of
**DSPM for AI and Data Governance.**
The professional will work closely with business stakeholders, compliance teams, and technical teams to protect sensitive information, reduce insider risks, and ensure regulatory compliance across the organization's data estate.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Data Loss Prevention (DLP)**

* Design, implement, and optimize Microsoft Purview DLP policies across Microsoft 365 services, endpoints, and supported third-party repositories.
* Define detection logic using Sensitive Information Types (SITs), trainable classifiers, custom classifiers, and EDM.
* Monitor DLP incidents and provide recommendations for policy tuning and risk reduction.
* Support deployment of Endpoint DLP controls for data exfiltration prevention.

**Data Classification & Labelling**

* Develop enterprise data classification frameworks aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
* Configure and manage Sensitivity Labels, Label Policies, Auto-labelling, and Mandatory Labelling strategies.
* Perform data discovery and classification workshops with business stakeholders.
* Support protection technologies including encryption, content markings, and access controls.

**DSPM for AI**

* Configure and manage Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI policies, assessments, and risk monitoring.
* Investigate AI-related data exposure, oversharing, and compliance risks.
* Develop AI governance use cases focused on responsible AI adoption and data protection.
* Deliver AI risk insights, posture reports, and executive dashboards.

**Data Governance**

* Configure and manage Microsoft Purview Data Governance capabilities and services.
* Drive data discovery, classification, cataloguing, and lineage initiatives.
* Develop governance frameworks for data quality, ownership, compliance, and lifecycle management.
* Produce governance metrics, compliance reports, and executive dashboards.

**Insider Risk Management**

* Configure and manage Insider Risk Management policies and analytics.
* Investigate insider risk alerts and collaborate with security, legal, compliance, and HR teams during investigations.
* Develop insider risk use cases focused on data theft, data leakage, security policy violations, and privilege misuse.
* Produce risk reports and executive dashboards.

**Data Lifecycle Management**

* Implement retention labels, retention policies, disposition reviews, and records management controls.
* Support regulatory and compliance requirements through information governance processes.
* Assist in defining data retention schedules and defensible data disposal strategies.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to automate lifecycle management processes.

**Consulting & Delivery**

* Conduct workshops, assessments, and requirement-gathering sessions.
* Develop solution designs, implementation plans, and governance frameworks.
* Support Proof of Concepts (PoCs), pilot deployments, and production rollouts.
* Create technical documentation, operational runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Provide troubleshooting support and operational guidance for Purview solutions.
* Stay current with Microsoft Purview roadmap, emerging data protection trends, and compliance requirements.

**Technical Skills**
**Skills and attributes for success**

* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Purview Data Security and Compliance solutions.
* Expertise in:

+ Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
+ Sensitivity Labels and Information Protection
+ Data Classification and Governance
+ Insider Risk Management
+ DSPM for AI
+ Data Governance
+ Data Lifecycle Management (desirable)
+ Records Management (desirable)
+ Communication Compliance (desirable)
+ eDiscovery (desirable)

* Experience with Microsoft 365 Compliance Centre and Microsoft Purview Portal.
* Understanding of regulatory frameworks such as GDPR, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, NIST, and data privacy requirements.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Microsoft Defender XDR, and Microsoft Security ecosystem integrations.
* Knowledge of cloud security and Microsoft 365 architecture.

**Professional Attributes**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
* Ability to translate business requirements into security controls and governance policies.
* Strong documentation and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Consulting mindset with client-facing experience.
* Strong collaboration and teamwork capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 9+ years of experience in data protection, information security, compliance, or Microsoft 365 security technologies.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
* Excellent analytical skills and knowledge of data analytics methods
* Demonstrated leadership abilities
* Excellent interpersonal, written, verbal, communication, and presentation skills

**Relevant certifications preferred:**

* Microsoft Certified: Information Protection Administrator (SC-400)
* Microsoft Certified: Security Administrator Associate (MS-500)
* Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals (SC-900)
* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100)

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Project management skills.
* CISSP, CISA, CISM, CEH, CIPPE/M, Technical (Vendor) Certifications.

title: TC - CS - DPP - Data Privacy - Manager
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting - Manager:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work Experience: 9 to 13 years
* Thorough detailed understanding of various Data privacy regulations and privacy concepts (for e.g. GDPR, CCPA/CPRA etc.)
* Experience in performing PIA, DPIA and Data mapping etc. At least 6-8 years of experience in Privacy domain

* Experience in developing DPP policies and procedures in compliance to GDPR/CCPA
* Experience in planning and implementation of data protection and privacy controls
* Experience in creating Data privacy related training content and imparting cross functional training on Data Privacy

* Candidate should be able to prioritize tasks and work accurately under pressure in order to meet deadlines
* Good Understanding of privacy engineering, privacy by design and privacy in cloud
* Good understanding/experience of privacy technology enablement and GRC tools
* Excellent documentation and communication skills

:
  
  

* Bachelor of Technology (BE/B.Tech), M.Tech or ME in Computer Science, MCA, MBA or equivalent.
* Certifications related to Data Privacy such as CIPP, CIPT, CIPM etc.
* Functional and non-functional privacy requirements definition and documentation experience
* Worked on tools like Onetrust, Trustarc, Servicenow

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

title: Sr. Associate, Global Treasury Risk
description:
**The Opportunity**
Under moderate supervision, provide support to finance function. Responsible for daily transactions, including expenses and payroll. Process payments, maintain cost reports and manage invoices. Update financial spreadsheets with daily transactions, prepare balance sheets and track and reconcile bank statements.
  
  
Avantor is looking for a dynamic, forward-thinking, and experienced
**Sr. Associate**
**with solid experience to manage various Credit Management and Supplier Management-related activities within the Treasury group.**
This role will be a full-time position based out of our Coimbatore office. Sr. Associate, Global Treasury Risk manages daily Credit Evaluations for Avantor global customer base, approve and assign appropriate credit limit and risk classification, facilitate payment terms approvals and changes in line with Delegation of Authority Matrix, ensure SOX Compliance to the objectives, evaluate legitimate bank change requests from suppliers, perform voice verification for new and existing vendors, identify and prevent fraudulent attempts, publish necessary weekly or monthly reports, approve customer and supplier account changes as necessary and perform other duties as assigned.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**

* Education: Any bachelor’s or master’s degree with finance background will be an added advantage.
* Experience: 2+ years of treasury / Credit Management, Accounts Payable or Accounts Receivables Experience in a multinational corporate environment is preferred.
* Should be Flexible to work in night shifts and working from the office in a hybrid model.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, and other relevant software
* Understanding of basic accounting, financial statements analysis, risk management and vendor management.
* Prior experience in process transition, stabilization and change management preferred.
* Ability to work as a part of a team, while providing a strong individual contribution.
* Ability to clearly communicate issues and recommend solutions to both Avantor associates and external parties in order to facilitate risk assessment and voice verification processes.
* Excellent attention to detail, judgment, flexibility, accountability, and dependability.
* Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written.
* Live up to ICARE values.

**Credit Management**
**How you will thrive and create an impact**

* Responsible for assigning Risk Classifications and Credit Evaluations for the Avantor Global customer base.
* Approve customer account reviews on a daily basis and assign risk classification at a customer level.
* Ensure appropriate credit and financial information is obtained and reviewed as part of the customer account review.
* Ensure the “Delegation of Authority” for approving Credit Limits is being adhered to.
* Ensure that “Security Instruments” are obtained in high risk situations to mitigate risk, including Letters of Credit, UCC’s and Guarantee’s.
* Ensure that SOX compliance for the Risk objectives are being met on an ongoing basis.
* Responsible for Risk Management Receivable Reporting which includes daily, weekly and monthly reporting:
* On a weekly basis create the weekly “Risk Management Receivable Trending Reports” for Sales, Finance, Risk and Accounting.
* On a monthly basis create and review the Bad Debt Assessment report which is used as the basis for deriving the Bad debt reserve.
* Perform quarterly financial reviews of VWR’s Top Vendors and post the report on the Risk Department Intranet Site for other departments viewing.
* Perform ongoing financial reviews and approve customer requests for special terms requests. This calls for evaluating the financial strength of the company making the terms request coupled with the profitability of the account and then obtaining Senior Management Approval as well.
* Perform financial reviews for customers with consignment Inventory as well as customer facing inventory making sure contract language is in place to protect VWR in the event of a termination of contract.
* Review and monitor all Avantor Global customers who have filed bankruptcy or have been placed for 3rd party collections.
* Approving customer account changes including name changes as a result of the customer being bought, sold, divested or changing the entity name.
* Responsible for collecting accounts receivable on accounts that are in Bankruptcy and are being sold as a Debtor in Possession.
* Responsible for locating and maintaining the “Risk Watch List” report which includes customers that are unable to pay VWR and additional bad debt reserve is taken.
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Supplier Voice Verifications**

* Validate the legitimacy of the request to ensure it is not a fraudulent attempt.
* Facilitate voice verification calls with legitimate supplier contact, Avantor relationship manager to blind confirm the bank details.
* Evaluate and submit the requests through Workflow for necessary approvals with 100% accuracy.
* Monitor and close the request with master data changes in ERP system.
* Maintain documentation for internal and external audits.

**Customer Refunds**

* Validate the legitimacy of the request to ensure it is not a fraudulent attempt.
* Facilitate voice verification calls with legitimate customer contact, engage key stakeholders as required to blind confirm the bank details.
* Evaluate and submit the requests through Workflow for necessary approvals with 100% accuracy.
* Monitor and close the request with master data changes in ERP system.
* Maintain documentation for internal and external audits.

**Process Improvement**

* Identify and implement improvements to treasury risk processes and systems.
* Continuously monitor industry trends and market changes to ensure credit management risk mitigation strategies remain up-to-date and relevant.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks and implement improvements to reduce bad debt exposure.

**Collaboration And Stakeholder Engagement**

* Work closely with key stakeholders across finance, accounting, treasury, Commercial, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable and Operations teams to gather necessary information to execute the tasks.

**Ad-hoc Financial Analysis**

* Provide ad-hoc financial analysis as requested by senior management to support decision-making.
* Work on adhoc reports to support revenue acceleration for the organization.

**Ensuring Compliance**

* Maintaining strong internal controls and adhering to relevant regulations such as SOX.
* Monitor the potential risk and raise red flags in case of any possible fraud threats.

**Disclaimer**
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
  
  
**Why Avantor?**
**Dare to go further in your career.**
Join our global team of 14,000+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life-changing science.
  
  
**The work we do changes people's lives for the better.**
It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle. It enables medical devices that help a little boy hear his mom's voice for the first time. Outcomes such as these create unlimited opportunities for you to contribute your talents, learn new skills and grow your career at Avantor.
  
  
We are committed to helping you on this journey through our diverse, equitable and inclusive culture which includes learning experiences to support your career growth and success. At Avantor, dare to go further and see how the impact of your contributions set science in motion to create a better world.
**Apply today!**

Please click here for our Privacy Policy which explains the purposes for which we will use your personal information and the ways in which we will handle and retain your information. It also explains the rights you have in relation to your information, and how to contact us with any queries or requests.

title: Junior advocate
description:
**Company Description**
Pnk Law is a growing legal practice based in Coimbatore, focused on delivering reliable and practical legal solutions to individuals and businesses. The firm values professionalism, integrity, and client-centered service, offering support across a range of legal matters. Team members collaborate closely to prepare cases, advise clients, and uphold high standards of advocacy and ethics. Pnk Law provides an environment where junior advocates can develop their skills, gain courtroom exposure, and build a strong foundation for a long-term legal career.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Junior Advocate role located in Coimbatore. The Junior Advocate will assist senior lawyers with legal research, drafting pleadings, preparing case notes, and reviewing documents. Responsibilities include attending client meetings, court hearings, and conferences, as well as maintaining case files and ensuring timely follow-up on legal procedures. The role also involves preparing briefs, organizing evidence, and coordinating with court staff and external stakeholders as required. The Junior Advocate is expected to maintain confidentiality, meet deadlines, and contribute to a collaborative and professional work environment.

**Qualifications**

* Recognized law degree (LL.B. or equivalent) and valid enrollment with the Bar Council or eligibility to enroll.
* Strong legal research and analytical abilities, with familiarity in using legal databases and reference materials.
* Proficiency in drafting legal documents, pleadings, notices, and correspondence with attention to detail and clarity.
* Effective communication skills, including professional client interaction and clear oral and written advocacy.
* Ability to manage multiple matters, organize case files, and work diligently under supervision in a fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to appear in court, observe proceedings, and gradually take on more independent advocacy responsibilities.
* Ethical conduct, commitment to confidentiality, and a strong interest in long-term professional growth in the legal field.
* Knowledge of local court procedures in Coimbatore and proficiency in English; familiarity with regional languages is an advantage.

**Job Description**
**Document Control Coordinator - Life Sciences & Quality Compliance**
**Location :-**

**Experience :-**
4+ Years
  
  
*Choosing Capgemini means choosing a place where you'll be empowered to shape your career, supported by a collaborative global community, and inspired to reimagine what's possible. Join us in helping leading Life Sciences organizations strengthen quality compliance, ensure regulatory readiness, and drive operational excellence through robust document management and quality systems.*
**Your Role**
As a
**Document Control Coordinator - Life Sciences & Quality Compliance**
, you will support the administration and execution of controlled quality documents across their lifecycle. You will ensure document accuracy, compliance with QMS procedures, audit readiness, and effective coordination between document owners, reviewers, approvers, and stakeholders in a regulated Life Sciences environment.
  
  
**In this role, you will:**

* Review documents for formatting standards, template compliance, metadata accuracy, version control, and completeness.
* Initiate, maintain, and monitor QMS workflows while coordinating with document owners, reviewers, approvers, and training teams.
* Maintain document control records, document numbering systems, workflow status, repository data, and audit trails.
* Track open requests, SLA commitments, and due dates, escalating risks and bottlenecks as required.
* Support document retrieval, traceability, regulatory inspections, audits, and evidence preparation activities.
* Generate KPI/SLA reports, backlog metrics, compliance dashboards, and process status reports.
* Ensure adherence to document management procedures while protecting data integrity and record accuracy.

**Your Profile**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Medical Sciences, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related discipline.
* 4+ years of experience in Document Control, Document Management, Quality Operations, Regulatory Support, Compliance, or related functions.
* Mandatory experience in Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, Medical Device, Healthcare, Medical, or other regulated industries.
* Hands-on experience within Compliance, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance (QA), Quality Systems (QMS), or regulated operational environments.
* Strong understanding of controlled document lifecycle management, records management, audit readiness, and data integrity principles.
* Experience working with Electronic Document Management Systems (eDMS) or controlled repositories such as:

+ Veeva Vault
+ MasterControl
+ OpenText / Documentum
+ TrackWise
+ Equivalent QMS/eDMS platforms

title: Design for Environment - Regulatory Product/ Material Compliance Engineer
description:
* Manage and validate IMDS submissions and supplier material declarations, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.
* Conduct material and substance compliance assessments against IMDS, ELV, GADSL, REACH, RoHS, SCIP, and applicable global regulations.
* Perform early\-stage DfE and compliance assessments from innovation/concept gates through product launch.
* Identify material, substance, and regulatory risks and provide actionable inputs for material selection and design decisions.
* Assess compliance with PFAS restrictions, SVHC, REACH Annex XVII, Proposition 65, Conflict Minerals, and emerging regulatory requirements.
* Review BOMs, material compositions, technical documentation, and supplier evidence to establish product compliance status.
* Define and communicate DfE and material compliance requirements to Engineering, Procurement, Product Management, and Suppliers.
* Act as SPOC for customer compliance queries, questionnaires, regulatory requirements, and compliance evidence.
* Track regulatory changes and translate them into product, material, supplier, and design requirements.
* Develop Power BI, Excel/VBA, and automation solutions for compliance tracking, data validation, reporting, and process efficiency.



 Skills \& Experience
